QuestInfo.name: Help the Excavation Site
QuestInfo.0: Winston has another favor to ask of you. Ask him what you need to do.
QuestInfo.1: You need to eliminate Dark Axe Stumps in #r#m102020400##k, and collect Axes from them. It almost sounds like you're doing the Stumps a favor...
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Dark Axe Stumps, collected Axes, and delivered them to Winston. Looks like the excavators are making progress, thanks to you! Axes are an important part of excavating, after all.

0.0: Actually, yes. I've another favor to ask. Our blasted axes keep rusting! Useless piffle, the lot of them. We need some quality, all-weather axes...like the ones those Dark Axe Stumps have stuck in them! You can wrestle a few axes away from them, what?

yes.0: Capital! Eliminate 50 Dark Axe Stumps, and get us 10 Axes. I've seen Dark Axe Stumps gathering at #m102020400#.

no.0: Come, come! The excavation hinges on you scavenging axes from animate tree stumps! You must take this more seriously!

1.0: I say, are those our new axes?

yes.0: Splendid! I say, darn fine work prying those axes away. You still look quite fresh, even...up for another challenge?

item.0: You've not enough axes there, sport. We need 10 axes, no less. Archaeological guidelines and all that, you know.
